prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop website composition comp, 1440x1024 landscape
Primary request: Design the opening screen of AmberLink, a Portuguese creative developer portfolio by Vinícius Lopes, as a game-inspired forest selection lobby. The visitor should immediately understand they can select Projects, About, Articles, Contact, or a small Snake game; this is a work showcase, not a sales landing page.
Scene/backdrop: A photorealistic, highly detailed temperate forest at blue-hour dawn, deep layered foliage, wet moss, realistic bark, subtle volumetric mist, with a single warm amber sunbeam and tiny amber resin inclusions in foreground leaves. Nature is the environment behind a polished interface, never a poster.
Subject: The portfolio navigation and real creative work selection, with a small featured work card and real labels in Portuguese.
Style/medium: Premium web product UI mockup, editorial and believable, natural photographic environment paired with restrained warm-amber glass surfaces and crisp cream typography. Strong real photographic detail in the nature background.
Composition/framing: Full viewport screen, no browser chrome. Top: slim compact AmberLink identity and small sound/theme controls. Left-center: clear title “Vinícius Lopes”, short line “código, movimento e luz”, brief description “Desenvolvimento criativo entre web, jogos e interação.” and one understated “Continuar” action. Right/center: a compact two-row bento selection board with five clearly separate route cards labelled “Projetos”, “Sobre”, “Artigos”, “Contato”, “Jogar Snake”; each card has a simple icon and amber active-state marker. Lower edge: one featured real project card placeholder labelled “Trabalhos recentes”, without made-up metrics or testimonials. The navigation board is the focal hierarchy and remains legible.
Lighting/mood: Cinematic early morning forest, rich but quiet, precise amber accents, inviting exploration.
Color palette: Near-black forest green, deep spruce, warm ivory, natural moss, muted honey amber.
Materials/textures: Photoreal foliage, damp bark, layered moss, minimal translucent amber resin panes with realistic refraction and fine highlights.
Text (verbatim): AmberLink; Vinícius Lopes; código, movimento e luz; Projetos; Sobre; Artigos; Contato; Jogar Snake; Trabalhos recentes; Continuar.
Constraints: Actual website screen composition, not a poster or concept painting. No people, no game characters, no fake statistics, no testimonials, no invented client outcomes, no logos besides the text AmberLink, no watermark, no extra legible copy, no garbled text, keep all interface text high contrast and compact.
